notes.title: Crystalline - Performance Update for macOS
notes.content:
Hello,

Those on macOS will notice an update today, this is for some performance tuning we did under the hood that should make the game run smoother.

Cheers!

notes.title: Kaori After Story - Available December 3rd!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28366024/dcc1e04afab11c9871b2d87ea2dc12abab329730.png

Hello,

We are excited to announce that Kaori After Story will be releasing on December 3rd!

Following Kaori's ending in ACE Academy, your now girlfriend has invited you to spend Christmas and New Years with her family. Your trip takes you to the countryside of Isokaze, where her parents and twin sisters are surprised to see that Kaori has brought a boy home! From meeting the parents, enjoying winter activities and spending intimate time with Kaori to learn more about her and her past, it will be a holiday to remember!

We hope you are looking forward to it. :^)
- PixelFade Team

notes.title: Crystalline - Officially Released!
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/vbp1qu8dhjo08q8/Crystalline-Released.png?dl=0

Hello,

Crystalline is officially released! Thank you for all the support you've shown us through development.

Please let us know your thoughts of Crystalline in a Steam review or on the discussion boards. You can also chat with us directly on our official Discordserver!

We hope you enjoy Crystalline as much as we enjoyed creating it. :^)

Happy Reading!!
- PixelFade Team

notes.title: Episode 5 Release Date!
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/6t90n6cu4txc0t7/Crystalline-EP5.png?dl=0

Hello!

The final chapter of Crystalline will be released on June 8th! Your game will automatically update and you can continue your journey right from where you left off.

If you'd like to support us and play Episode 5 now, please feel free to check out our Patreon for Alpha Access!

As always, please let us know your thoughts of Crystalline in a Steam review or on the discussion boards. ːsteamhappyː

Hope you are all excited for the final chapter of Crystalline!!
- PixelFade Team

notes.title: Episode 3 Available Now!
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/mq7z5kd9wqql0ut/SteamImage.png?dl=0

Hello!

Crystalline Episode 3 is available now! Your game should automatically update and you can continue your journey right from where you left off.

Although we have resolved all the reported bugs during beta testing, you may run into the occasional one here and there as we continue to develop the project. You may also run into an inconsistent/missing voice over line but please rest assured it'll be updated within a week or so of the release date!

As always, please let us know your thoughts on Crystalline in a Steam review or on the discussion boards. ːsteamhappyː

Thanks and happy reading!!
- PixelFade Team

notes.title: Early Access Released!
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/g6b211iw0ujwxb0/Early%20Access.png?dl=0

Hello!

Crystalline is now available on early access which currently includes chapters 1 and 2. Want to see if a choice-driven, fantasy adventure visual novel featuring full voice-over is right for you? Check out the free demo which includes the entirety of Chapter 1!

Please let us know your thoughts on the discussion boards or in a Steam review! We love to incorporate player feedback into our development process. :-)

Thanks and happy reading!!
- PixelFade Team
